shell_tradeoff.actual_sign: The center's sign field is s_M(x)=sgn(sin(Mx_1))
shell_tradeoff.shell_scale: For fixed alpha, H_(alpha,M,R)=Theta_alpha(1/(R+1))=Theta_alpha(M/N), with exact finite-sum interpretation when R is bounded
shell_tradeoff.coupled_tradeoff: Elementary comparison of the omitted tail above N with the fixed-ratio harmonic window below N gives int(f_N^2-1)^2>=c_alpha H_(alpha,M,R) for every degree-N f_N with exact sign s_M
shell_tradeoff.fixed_shell_consequence: If a sequence or mixture in the exact lamellar sign class has nonvanishing expected H_(alpha,M,R), then E W_N=Omega(C_N^2)=Omega(N^4)
shell_tradeoff.scope_guard: The relation is an inverse theorem for the exact one-coordinate lamellar square-wave sign class only; it is not an inverse theorem for arbitrary nodal geometry
